t:
Go to the June Temple and activate the Defiled Altar.
Hold on until the leader of the demons, Actpaz the Invader, shows itself and defeat it. Return back to Lord Zullo after.

My last clue must ensure the disclosure of our secret identity. There is an ancient June Altar in the temple, full of magical powers that can be awakened by a drop of your blood.
When you reach the June Temple, approach the altar. Cut your finger and smear a drop of blood on its surface to activate its vibrant energy. Waves of demons will drown you and you will have to withstand their assault until their leader appears, and kill it.
Keep your eyes open. You will notice this battle will differ from any other. What's the difference? This will be the hint that gives you the key to understanding who we are.
Did the demons follow their leader and fall like flies? Did you notice anything strange?

Well, I think you have everything you need to draw final conclusions.
Parable end? Oh yes, you need to hurry. You're running out of time as usual...
Kill a Vampire Cultist, open the bottle with Osip's spark over the corpse, and talk to him after resurrection.

The problem is that cultists are exhausted not from the cavern air. Someone is draining their power. Most likely the corrupt vampire cast away in the temple a long time ago. You must find and kill him while not crippling its valuable corpse.
Take this jar which contains Osip's spark. We have kept it safely here with the help of Astral essence. Crack open the jar over the vampire's body and let it work its magic. Try not to drink it by mistake...
Ah, what? Already? I though I would sit in this bottle for eternity. All my pyramid of needs of my spark is numb. Oh, my curve of moral priorities is numb!

This is too unusual. It's like I'm wearing my mother's night gown. This body... Sickly and frail. It's not match compared with my previous one. It feels like I don't have enough space in this body and what's worse, long har just like a woman. I just want to chop it off with my sword right now! What a shame!
Bah, what am I saying? I thank you. At least I can breath, move my fingers, smell aromas. By the way... I smell something... It's in your bag. What has this delicious smell? Pies? I've not eaten anything for 300 years. I beg you, give me some! And if you won't share the I'll... Slap you across the face! Oh my, that must of been the sissy Elf part of me talking. It's going to take some time getting used to this body. Ah, it feels great to be alive again...
Persuade Osip to leave the body so the Cultist's Soul will tell the name of its leader.

Murderer! How dare you let this commoner into my noble body!
Do you belong to those who drink cheap liquor out of crystal glass? Who throws dirty linen into the dragonbone chest? He will gnaw my nails, ruin my liver, stain my honor... Wait, was that a belch?! Oh, Lord, how could you let this happen to your trusted servant?
I command you exorcise this demon from my body! At once! I beg of you... I can reward you greatly. I will tell you the name of my master. The sacred name of the one who cursed dragons called Prisoner of Peace. After all, you do want to know what our motives are, right?
Oh, at last that ugly thing has left my beautiful body. Every inch of my body feels filthy. I want to scrape everything inside me with a piece of dragon skin.

Your part of the deal is done. It will be an honor to reveal the name of my Lord. Bless him! But I warn you, your heart will be hurt by the truth.
You should know, the cultists are led by the one whom those damned dragons call World Prisoner, because they are not allowed to call him by his real name...
He is none other than the glorious Sarn.
Kill the ancient demon, Vur'tazz the Ravager, in the June Temple and read a scroll with words of gratitude to the League at the main square in Nezebgrad.

Now comes the last lesson to love your former foes. It will require your modesty and generosity.
Soon the Path will lead you to June Temple and a very fierce enemy will stand between you and the Mentor. It is an ancient demon that we have already encountered in the distant past. Vur'tazz the Ravager is very tricky, wise and powerful. Defeating him is just half the battle.
For the second half, you must return back to the square of Nezebgrad and read this scroll loudly in front of all. It says that the League's Chosen One was first to reach the temple and defeat the demon.
I know it is difficult to give your victory to your opposer especially when you have suffered much from your former enemy. Nonetheless, after this deed, you won't have any doubts. You will accept the League like a friend and only hope for salvation.
Have you read the note? I know it's not easy to give the enemy a glorious victory, but that's what you must do.

Yes, I saw everything from my window. It seems as if your voice was trembling while you were reading out this lie. I understand where you're coming from and people need to understand that times have changed. The League is no longer our main enemy. It's time to recall the Grand Astral Campaign when Nezeb and Skrakan fought together.
Yes, the war helped to lift the country out of the rubble and create a real empire. But now the war had hindered the development process. We could have achieved much more results in times of peace: revive the economy, conduct more scientific research, recover infrastructure at unprecedented levels. This country has great prospects, but the inertia is dragging it on the battlefield.
Perhaps a joint struggle against demons will help people stop thinking that Empire can't exist without fighting the League. War is too weak to boost great power. If we can find other reasons, we will build towards a brighter future for all. Maybe if we devote more resources to understand our history, heritage of Zem, Junes, dragons, the past can give us the idea which unites us and lead to common objective.
In any case, now it is just the idea to fight against demons together with the League. We can't let down Nezeb's noble cause!
Kill the ancient demon, Vur'tazz the Ravager, in the June Temple and read a scroll with words of gratitude to the Empire at the main square in Novograd.

Now comes the last lesson to love your former foes. It will require your modesty and generosity.
Soon the Path will lead you to June Temple and a very fierce enemy will stand between you and the Mentor. It is an ancient demon that we have already encountered in the distant past. Vur'tazz the Ravager is very tricky, wise and powerful. Defeating him is just half the battle.
For the second half, you must return back to the square of Novograd and read this scroll loudly in front of all. It says that the Empire's Chosen One was first to reach the temple and defeat the demon.
I know it is difficult to give your victory to your opposer especially when you have suffered much from your former enemy. Nonetheless, after this deed, you won't have any doubts. You will accept the Empire like a friend and only hope for salvation.
Have you read the note? I know it's not easy to give the enemy a glorious victory, but that's what you must do.

Yes, I saw everything from my window. It seems as if your voice was trembling while you were reading out this lie. I understand where you're coming from and people need to understand that times have changed. The League is no longer our main enemy. It's time to recall the Grand Astral Campaign when Nezeb and Skrakan fought together.
We are stuck in this war, addicted to it. Simple answers, simple meaning for everyone... If you want to become a hero, hate your enemy. One needs a common foe and the Empire has filled that role. War has become a drug.
But what if after the combat is over, we run away in different directions? Proud Elves separate, Gibberlings call themselves sovereign, paying us back for the fact that we needed them only because of mystery of Astral journeys.
Yes, the demons war will keep our six races together. But what will happen when the war is over? The League and Empire will be enemies again? Or maybe new alliances will appear? Elves and Arisen, united by passion for knowledge and beauty. Kanians and Xadaganians remembering that their differences are negligible. Gibberlings and Orcs will unite due to their outcast, love for ale and joys of life. Do these world of thoughts propose a better future than where we are now?
In any case, we have no other choice. We must try. And with Tensess' help, we will succeed!
Sneak into Demons' City, break into the demonic portal and summon Yasker.

We begin our mission, and our main target is Gorluxor. Yes, it was him! The City Council did its best to find out the identity of the so-called Master. This time we will finish him once and for all!
The whole operation is under my personal control. It means that I'll always be by your side. I will give you instructions, assign with new tasks and keep you posted.
Let's begin. The demonic aura prints have been thoroughly investigated in the ZIT, and our chances have been calculated carefully. Now we are sure that we can successfully break into the demonic teleporters.
Every time you find a demonic portal, just touch it. I will use the Portal Key then to enter the teleporting system.
Your first task is simple: sneak into the Demons' City and find the demonic portal. I hope I don't need to explain that you will need help of friends to accomplish this mission.
I never doubted in you! But keep in mind, your next task will be more difficult.
Access the second demonic portal by defeating Nogrom and talk to Yasker.

Let's continue. The Teonomicon that you managed to find is an invaluable source of knowledge about the cultists and the demons. We now have good information about their hierarchy and I can warn you about the coming battles.
There are many formidable foes in this place. You will have to vanquish all of them in order to reach Gorluxor himself. Your first target is Nogrom, the head of the tower guards. You must be careful - it's said that he is an ogre armed with a club large enough to clear the battlefield in one swipe!
Before he himself will fight you, you'll need to attract his attention by killing the cultists. Gather the cultists' blood and pour it before him - this should put him in a rage.
I'm sure he won't be very happy to see you, so prepare yourself for a tough battle. After you defeat the great ogre, you should be able to gain access to the second demonic portal.
Come on! We have a lot more work to do!
Access the third demonic portal by defeating War'kaz the Mindreaver and talk to Yasker.

The second objective is War'kaz the Mindreaver, the commander of the demons.
I will now be able to use this portal to teleport us to the city's barracks.
There you will find him, guarded by many of his minions. War'kaz possesses incredible strength as well as intelligence. Everything you do, he can do better. There's a reason he's the commander of legions of terrible beasts.
It won't be easy to defeat him, but I believe in you.
As soon as he is defeated, access the third demonic portal and I will come to your side once again.
If you were able to defeat War'kaz, I believe we truly have a chance to defeat Gorluxor himself.

There's no time to relax! There are still many battles to be fought. However, it seems that this portal is not completely functioning yet. I will need some time to investigate. I'll inform you as soon as we can continue on our journey.
Access the fourth demonic portal by defeating Zalmar the Twisted and talk to Yasker.

I will now be able to teleport you to the heart of the demons' city. There you'll be able to fulfill your next mission and continue to purge this place of evil.
I hope you already know how dangerous magic can be. Knowledge about these forces will be useful in your next trial. Up ahead lies Zalmar the Twisted, an evil demon that will attack you with the destructive power of the Astral.
After Zalmar is defeated, you should be able to find the fourth demonic portal. Access it and once again I will come to guide you further.
I won't lie - defeating Zalmar would be a hard task for even a Great Mage. I hope that you will prevail.
By defeating Zalmar we are now one step closer to defeating Gorluxor!
Access the fifth demonic portal by defeating Armando de Doucer and talk to Yasker.

How do you feel about Elves? And what about vampire Elves, hm? Glad to see you share my sentiments - they must be eliminated! In this tower lives Armando de Doucer, the head of the vampires. He's died once before, and now it's time to remind him how it feels by killing him once again.
The continual resurrection of this vampire, like Gorluxor's resurrection, is one of the mysteries that we cannot solve right now. The answer will come in time.
Our top priority is to defeat him. In the Teonomicon he's listed as the Supreme Prince of the Elves - an arrogant buffoon, just like all of his kind! Teach him how to be modest and then access the fifth demonic portal.
It's now time to teleport to the next part of the tower where I believe an old friend is waiting for you.
Access the sixth demonic portal by defeating Strina the Fierce and talk to Yasker.

Now you must prepare to face Strina the Fierce - an Orc with the unique ability to control death magic! I have to admit, we should have taken more care to see that she did not join the enemy. Having her become a faithful disciple of Gorluxor was a huge blow to the Empire.
Right now we have no time for long talks and regrets. She's an enemy and so she must die. The demons' cemetery is her domain, and that's just where I'm going to send you.
Her powers are amplified in that cursed place, so prepare to do battle with a horde of undead. As soon as you defeat her, access the sixth portal so I may join you.
The Lady of Death... Those cultists love fancy names!
So, you've dealt with this obstacle as well. Good job! I'm sure the shamans will be especially grateful that you have destroyed such a traitor to their kind.
Access the seventh demonic portal by defeating Kazul the Astral Watcher and talk to Yasker.

Now I will teleport you to the foot of this tower. There you will begin the final part of this journey. It will be a bloody path, for Gorluxor's watchman is waiting for you there.
The beast is a giant eye monster named Kazul the Astral Watcher. Its sole purpose is to protect its master at all costs, and the monster is incredibly dangerous. After the victory, access the seventh demonic portal and I'll give you your last task.
Here is the tower of our common enemy! If I had been wiser in the past, we would not have had to come here, but I suppose it's too late to think about that.
Just a little more, a little more and we'll be at the final battle - the most difficult of them all.
Defeat Gorluxor and find and destroy the source of his revival. Report to Yasker when you are finished.

Now listen to me very carefully. We have gone through a damned nightmare to get where we are now. You might think that I was a bit careless in this journey, but that's not true.
I... I was very afraid that we would fail. This mission can be compared to that of Nezeb and Skrakan during the Great Astral Campaign - extremely important, but almost certainly hopeless. I hope our mission has a happier ending than theirs.
There's only one thing left to do now - kill Gorluxor. Gorluxor has already died and resurrected despite all known laws of resurrection. That means your task is to not only kill him, but make sure he stays dead.
The Teonomicon says nothing about how he resurrects. I believe he must have some kind of ancient artifact that allows him do this. Or perhaps he has created a magical device of some sort - it doesn't matter.
After you defeat him, you must find the source of his revival and destroy it. Examine everything in his room very carefully... Everything is of interest to us! I will be waiting for you in Nezebgrad, awaiting news of victory!

We did it!
We won! I'm so grateful to you. The whole Empire owes you!
Bring magical chain to Yasker and tell him everything that happened in the Abyss.
This strange thing looks like some sort of chain... It's pulsing with magic! You'd better take it to Yasker and tell him what's happened here!
I think we should celebrate our final victory over the demons and their cultists! What's the matter? What do you have to tell me?

No way!
Are you sure this mysterious creature was the true "Master"? And Gorluxor was his puppet? But who is he? We have to figure out.
Go to Gorluxor's Tower, access the first demonic portal, and talk to Aidenus.

Listen carefully.
We are about to start the most important mission, nearly as significant as the Great Astral Campaign. We must put an end to the demonic threat. The time has come to get rid of the Master - or should I rather call him Gorluxor, as this is his true identity!
Now that you can enter the Demons' City, we will challenge our sworn enemies. Don't be afraid, I will lead the whole operation.
We spent a lot of time studying the Portal Key. All portals on Yazes Shard were once activated using it. As we found out, the key has something to do with several other portals located in the Demons' City. But they are sealed, and it's impossible to activate them from the outside.
Before you throw yourself into the battle, we need to make sure that we will be able to control the demonic teleporting system.
Here, take this cultist attire. It will enable you to enter the Demons' city unnoticed. Find the portal and touch it. If everything goes well, I will reconfigure it using the Portal Key.
I knew that you could do it!
So, we are now inside Gorluxor's Tower and have accessed the first portal. This mission certainly has a promising start.
Access the second demonic portal by defeating Nogrom and talk to Yasker.

We must move on. After examining the Teonomicon, I found that you will meet with many demonic commanders in this place. You will have to deal with all of them to reach our main objective - Gorluxor.
The first obstacle is Nogrom. He's an ogre like no other with armor forged of the strongest metal, and his brutal rage is enough to take down any enemy. To prove yourself worthy to him, you'll need to attract his attention by killing the cultists for their blood. Take the cultists' blood and pour it before Nogrom to call him.
He definitely won't be glad to see you, so you must prepare yourself for a long battle. Overcome the great ogre and then you'll be able to access the second demonic portal.
Seizing the Tower will not be easy, but we have no choice!
Pull yourself together! We have a lot to do!
Access the third demonic portal by defeating War'kaz the Mindreaver and talk to Aidenus.

Our next target is War'kaz, the commander of the demons. This portal will give us access to the Tower's barracks where you can find him.
I'm sure you've already fought many demons, but War'kaz is infamous throughout the Astral. He has destroyed more citizens of the League and the Empire than you can imagine.
You and your allies must fight in perfect unison to take him down! Once War'kaz is defeated, access the third demonic portal at once so that we may continue.

The power of War'kaz was equal to ten octulhus! It's no wonder he became the leader of the demons. Now he is dead. Unfortunately, I can't teleport you to the next area of the city yet. I need some time to analyze the portal. I'll inform you when we can continue on our journey.
Defeat Zalmar the Twisted and break into the fourth portal.

Now is not the time to slack off. We must continue to infiltrate the Tower! Your next mission will lead you to the heart of this cursed place.
It is an uncanny area full of Astral magic where the wicked demon Zalmar reigns. I hope you are adept at dealing with powerful magic, for these are the strongest you will have ever encountered.
The demon's death will allow us to take one more step towards our goal - defeating Gorluxor once and for all. Blast Zalmar into oblivion and access the next demonic portal.
This place is full of dark magic! Had we arrived any later, nothing could have stopped the demons' onslaught.
Access the fifth demonic portal by defeating Armando de Doucer and talk to Yasker.

The next foe is our old acquaintance - Armando de Doucer! That Elven traitor is up to his old tricks again. He has been living in the Tower and acting as one of Gorluxor's closest advisors.
We're getting closer to Gorluxor, closer to revealing the secret to his continuous revival. Obviously, it's the same power that allowed Armando to resurrect again and again. I hope this will be the last time we have to face that twisted bastard!
I suppose you are well aware of the abilities the vampires possess by now. Armando has mastered them all, and perhaps even darker powers we cannot deduce. Conquer him and access the fifth demonic portal.
This is an awful place drowned in blood...
Now the floor is red with Armando de Doucer's own blood. I hope this is the end for him.
Access the sixth demonic portal by defeating Strina the Fierce and talk to Yasker.

Your next destination is an even darker region - the demons' cemetery. Unfortunately, it's not a place where the Astral creatures are buried. It's a haunted burial ground guarded by an Orc named Strina the Fierce. She has an uncanny ability to use death magic, and is a master of the undead!
It's time to end her dark reign. Send her to the grave and access the sixth portal. We are near, very near to Gorluxor, and nothing must stand in our way!

Our scouts tell us that Strina didn't have a clue about her amazing powers until recently. When she discovered them, she decided to use them to spread evil throughout the world. We're lucky that she didn't decide to aid the Empire.
Now Strina's journey is over... Hopefully she has found peace.
Access the seventh demonic portal by defeating Kazul the Astral Watcher and talk to Yasker.

The end is near - I can sense it! Now I can send you to the foot of Gorluxor's Tower. Kazul the Astral Watcher is now the only foe standing between you and Gorluxor, but don't think that eliminating his personal watchman will be an easy task. They say he can kill his enemies with a single look.
Access the seventh demonic portal after you defeat him. Then I will come to your side to give you your last task. After that, this nightmare should all be over.
Here it is - the entrance to Gorluxor's Tower!
The road to Gorluxor now lies open before us. Victory is near!
Defeat Gorluxor and find and destroy the source of his revival. Report to Aidenus when you are finished.

Before I give you the last task, I would like to say something very important. You are the main figure in this story! If it wasn't for you, I would be sitting in my tower knowing nothing about the imminent danger. We would doubtlessly have been destroyed by the new demonic invasion. My crown goes off to you.
Now let's get back to business. I'm sure that Gorluxor is the reason for our troubles. That traitorous Xadaganian Great Mage was so insulted by Yasker that he decided to destroy the world. His lust for power clouded his reason.
He joined the enemy and became the leader of the cultists. I don't know how he managed to do it, and I have no idea how he manages to resurrect after death. There's something unnatural about it. Gorluxor must be in possession of powerful artifact that's beyond our understanding.
In short, you need to find his source of revival and destroy it after Gorluxor's dead. Examine his chambers thoroughly after your victory. It must be hidden in there somewhere. When you have destroyed it, return to Novograd for a grand reception!
I'm anxiously waiting for your latest report. Gorluxor must be destroyed - forever!
This is a great victory! Thank you, the savior of the League!
Bring magical chain to Aidenus and tell him everything that happened in the Abyss.
This strange thing looks like some sort of chain... It's pulsing with magic! You'd better take it to Aidenus and tell him what's happened here!
I think today should be declared a national holiday. No more demons and cultists will plague our lands again! Hm... you seem like you have something on your mind.

No way!
Are you sure this mysterious creature was the true "Master"? And Gorluxor was his puppet? But who is he? We have to figure out.
Protect Dakkar de Desiraes as he conducts the Salvation Ritual.

Allow me to introduce myself in a manner more worthy of an Elven prince - I am Dakkar de Desirae, a demonologist. Sounds better than "The Nameless One," wouldn't you say? I'm happy that we could meet once more.
But, I'm afraid that now is not the time to be happy. Meeting you and the events that happened on the allod forced me to change my decision. I blamed myself for everything that happened at the castle and that's why I became a hermit. But you can't escape yourself... I left the allod and started to rebuild the picture of what happened piece by piece. And as it turns out, I'm not the one to blame for the curse after all!
Now I'm here to right the wrongs.
I must complete the Salvation Ritual to save Svetlana but it's not something I can do without your help. The darkness here has turned her into a witch. You must distract her while I conduct the ritual.
Use this chalk wisely - you can only draw one magic circle on the chapel floor. The witch can't see you until you leave the circle, so she'll be searching for you blind. Don't try to attack her because you'll destroy the circle. You must hold out until I complete the Ritual. The enemy will try to stop us, so you must deal with them, while I work on saving Svetlana.
I'll start as soon as you're ready, just tell me when.

It is done! Svetlana is by my side once more... long have I waited for this day. It was your bravery that helped me complete the Salvation Ritual. Thank you from the bottom of my heart. I swear that we shall never forget you!
Destroy the Curse on the Valir castle and report to Dakkar de Desirae.

Now we're left with the most important task.
Svetlana has been saved but the castle is still cursed. It can never be lifted while the guardian, a loyal servant of Tep, lives. His name is Mor'Ghuun and he is one of Tep's monstrous creations, born of some ancient magic I have yet to learn. It was his appearance that killed all of the castle's inhabitants and condemned them to eternal torture.
We won't have to wait for him too long. We've intruded into his domain - we stood against him and challenged him openly. He'll be here any minute.
I hope you are strong enough to destroy the Curse. You, because I will remain with Svetlana - she needs my help and support right now.
Indeed, this will be a great feat! A victory over Castle Blight!
That's the end of that story! The enemy has been destroyed and evil has been punished. One day people will return to the castle and the sun will shine on it once more.
Meet Khoor-Tarr the Silver-Voiced in the settlement at the Guarded Cliff.

Aho, child!

Today is the big day - the day when your destiny will be decided! Today the voices of the ancestors will tell how strong your spirit is. Today you will become an adult... or die!

Are you anxious? You should be! You are at the doorstep of your adult life. If the spirits favor you, today you will finally leave your home in the village, ward off your past, and reach out for the future, eysh!

Khoor-Tarr, the Senior Trainer, will say his parting words to those who will die today! Hurry up!
Aho! Your frriends are all waiting for the final directions from the old Priden.

Death is death, and life is life. One way or another, you will die today in the Thicket of the Primals. Youth will day and give way to maturity. The way you will live your adult life depends on how you will enter it.
Find the Dragon's Eye in the distant mountains, defeat the Blazing Guardian, take the Crimson Flower, and return to Mirrah at the Council Rock.

Listen closely, little brother. Akkya has failed, and it means he no longer can be the leader. Scar has not forgotten the humiliation and will most likely claim his right to be chosen as the new leader at the Pack Council. You won't defeat him on your own, and the wolves won't help you.

There is a place to the North from here which we call the Dragon's Eye. Many moons ago a giant died there, and Crimson flowers grew from his blood.

Every single creature in the forest fears the light of those flowers... Except for you! I can see its sparkles in your eyes. Believe an old panther, little brother - only the light of the Crimson Flower will help you defeat Scar.

Go to the distant mountains, find the Crimson Flower and return to the Council. Today death will be standing behind your back, little brother!
Don't waste your time, little brother! The pack will now fight for the right to become the new leader!
The Crimson Flower... Take it away from me, little brother, its Light is hurting my eyes!
Challenge Scar and defeat him using the Crimson Flower.

The slug is back! Right on time for supper, haha!

Scar will eat your giblets, and I will gnaw your bones... Sweet, crunchy bones! Yum-yum! Arooo!
Don't worry about me, young wolf... I am old, but I will tear apart anyone who thinks that they can turn the Dead Wolf into the dead meat!
Well done, young wolf. We have chosen you for a reason... The light in your eyes will show you the way!
Go back to Khoor-Tarr in the settlement at the Guarded Cliff.

Light and Fire are the two greatest elements, young wolf. Your people were born out of Fire. It kept you warm and protected you, helped you survive severe frosts and find a way through the dark. Fire gave you Light.

Fire is ancient, and it is burning in the heart of each Priden who has been to the Thicket of the Primals. Light is young, and not many of you can accept its power. Light cuts its way through the dark that's surrounding the world, and it shines so brightly that even Death fears it!

Today you've faced Death, young Priden, and defeated it. Many cheat their Death to get out of the Thicket alive, but the ones who defeat it come out immortal!

Go, young Priden. Your life lies ahead of you, and Light is shining upon your path. Return to your Trainer and tell him, a new star is shining above the Thicket of the Primals. A star ignited with your Light!
Ay-hya! Welcome back! It's good to see you are alive!
Show your skills using the Combat Dummy.

To conceive the wisdom of our ancestors, you will have to go to the Thicket of the Primals.

You will meet there the spirits of the Primals - of those who have turned fierce and unreasonable predators into prroud hunters and wise keepers of harmony.

Remember: the Thicket is a dangerous place. Many of my disciples are buried beneath the roots of the trees that have seen the beginning of this world.

Take the weapon from the stand and show me your fighting skills. The weak ones won't survive, eysh!
I see a child in front of me, and I don't know whether it will grow into a true Priden!
Good, child. I see you've learnt something from me.
Drink the Shamanic Potion and go to the Thicket of the Primals.

Good. Now listen closely! I have brrewed a potion that will allow you to step on the path that can only be seen by ethereal spirits and that will lead you to the Thicket. No one knows whether it exists for rreal, or it only lives in our hearts and memory. But each Priden has met their Primal, and that encounter has defined their lives, eysh! Now this path is opened to you.

I don't know whether the Primals will be favorable to you, but remember that death stands by your side. The cub will die today, but will the Priden live? All depends on you, eysh!
Hey, who are you? You smell tasty... Yum!
Kick the jackal and run away from the tiger.

Meat! Tasty, tasty meat! Tonight we will feast, yum!

Scar is coming! Scar rules this forest. He will kill you and eat your liver!

And I will eat your eyes and gnaw your bones! Ha-ha!
A stranger cub? What are you doing in my lair?!
Convince the wolves to help you drive Scar away.
You intruded my home! I will kill you!
Don't be scared, cub. We won't hurt you.

Damned tiger! I'm sure that he is responsible for the death of our children, and now he is after you, that odious beast! Scar is vengeful. He will not forget the humiliation, and you don't even have fangs yet!

Take a broken fang of one of your kinsmen. It is pretty sharp, so it can even pierce the tiger's skin!

Are you speaking about Scar? Rawr! The wicked cat deserves a good thrashing. I think that scoundrel killed our babies, but wolves stand no chance against a tiger.

Wait... I can smell him!
Go hunting with Itkan and show him you can stand up for yourself, then go to the Council Rock.

The Pack Council will begin soon, cub. We have broken the Forest Law by taking you away from Scar, and he will come to the Rock to take back what's his. Your only chance to survive is to show him that you are a hunter and not a prey. But you're so weak...

Don't worry, Itkan will teach you. Go to the forest with him, listen to his advice, and if the forest favors you, you will ascend the Council Rock as a young wolf, not as a helpless cub!

This place is called the Council Rock. All hunters who live in the forest belong to the Pack. Remember that, cub. Your brother may be different from you, but you have the same blood in your veins, you are of the same the Pack. The whole world is a forest, and you are either a hunter or a prey!
Talk to Akkya and wait for the Pack's decision.

Your only chance to survive is to become a part of the Pack. The world is cruel to loners, but when you're in the Pack, you become something bigger. The Pack will give you strength and protect you. Only with your brothers by your side you can challenge the whole world and win. To hunt and fight together - this is what's it all about!

I spoke my word for you to Akkya. If he accepts you to the pack, you will become one of us, a true hunter, and no one in the forest will dare to call you a prey!
I am a leader, not a governor. I lead the Pack, I don't give orders. May the Pack say its word!
The Pack has spoken, young hunter. Now you are one of us. We are of the same blood!

I see no fear in your eyes, strange cub. You can become a hunter... if you survive.

Look, here goes Scar, your enemy. Look into his eyes, cub. If I smell fear in you, I will renounce you, and nothing will save you from prey's fate!
Obtain 3 portions of honey from Beehives and bring to Belly at the Council Rock.

Ah, young cub! You want the old bear to share some wisdom with you? Huh... Here, listen to my first lesson. Everything in the world comes at a price! Bring me some honey, kid! I'm old, fat and too lazy to run from the bees. If you want to get something, you must give something first.

Just don't harm the hives, little brother, and don't take all honey. Instead of draining one hive entirely, take a little honey from many hives. Remember - you should only take as much as nature can give you, and not more!
Where is my honey, little brother?

Oh, what a smell! What can be better than fresh honey? Only honey that didn't get you stung, haha.

This is what the Forest Law is about, little brother. When you live in harmony with nature, you can only take what others are giving you, and not give away more than you have in return. Everything in the world is connected, little brother. The hunter is bound to the prey, the bees are bound to honey, the river is bound to the rain, and life is bound to death. Everything obeys the same laws, the laws of balance, the Forest Law. The one who breaks it becomes an outlaw, and nature does not tolerate infringement.
Obtain 3 pieces of deer meat and return to Mirrah at the Council Rock.

Do you know the Word of Blood, little brother? You and I - we are of the same blood! And this is not just words. The hunters' blood runs through your veins, through the veins of the wolves, of Boa, even of the old clumsy bear, even though he prefers honey to meat. We are the hunters! The rest are our prey!

Start the hunt, get some deer meat, and you will see that my words make sense.

I gave up a bull to make the Pack listen to my words, and I can see that I was not mistaken, little brother. You are a real hunter. I don't know what your future will bring, but I'm sure you'll never become a prey - neither of Scar nor anyone else. If you will ever die, you will die in battle, because me and you - we are of the same blood!
Awake spirits in the Thicket of the Primals using the Shattered Bone and return to Boa at the Council Rock.

The funny cub wants to learn from Boa? That's amus-sing... Alright, Boa is bored, s-so Boa will have some fun and entertain the cub.

Look, cub, this-s bone shard contains many ans-swers to your ques-stions. You don't believe? Jus-st touch anything with it, and you will see...
Well, cub... Did you enjoy the lesson?

Now you undersstand... Everything in this world has a ssoul - sstones, trees, and even bones. Your people call it "tya", don't assk me how I know that. Boa is old and knows many things. Too many...

Just remember that each your sstep is imprinted in this world. Nothing comess out of nowhere. Nothing disappears without leaving a trace. You can only understand the world if you look deep into it... Into its ssoul! But not every ssoul will gladly disclose its ssecrets, haha.

Now walk on, foolish cub. Boa is tired and needs resst... Long resst...
Talk to Akkya at the Council Rock and participate in the Big Hunt.

Hey, little brother! Akkya is starting the Big Hunt, and we are only waiting for you!

The Big Hunt is not only a way to find food - it's a celebration, a ritual of hunt!

The wolves have traced a deer, a giant deer... A great prey for young hunters!

Enough with the talking. Go to Akkya, he will show your place among the hunters.
Have a nice hunt, wolf cub!
Well done, young wolf. And I... I failed. I'm too old and weak... The Pack needs a new leader!
Find 3 Yasker Hawk Badges and bring them to Crazystorm the Merciless in Nezebgrad.

It's time for you to head down into Lab Thirteen. How will your journey end? I've no idea. It's entirely possible that you'll die and I'll need to kill your lost soul myself. However, if you do manage to survive in there, then I have a request.
We recently got a platoon of Yasker Hawks deployed to the lab. They're really the best of the best! They went inside days ago, but they never returned.
I knew every one of those soldiers personally. And I am very, very interested in learning their fate, do you understand? And if something terrible happened to them... Well, then find their bodies and collect their badges. Their place isn't here, but in a proper memorial!
"None forgotten, nothing forgotten" a slogan of the Imperial Sentinels. When you find them, bring them to Crazystorm the Unyielding in Nezebgrad. He'll give them to the proper authorities.
Ah, it's you! Got good news for me?

What are these? Yasker Hawk badges?! Where did you get these? Ah, I see... Let me see them. Igor Smazhin... Bang the Bloodthirsty... Sarbaz Menkare... Ugh, these are best of the best!
Thank you for bringing me their badges. I believe that you deserve a reward, even though they have fallen by your hand. You have given them peace and saved them from eternal madness.
Argh! Damn these labs! And all this magic-shmagic... damnit as well! It's the root of all miseries, and the reason we keep losing so many good men!
Kill Stepmother and report back to Elizaveta Rysina.

So, are you ready to head into Lab Thirteen? You should know that this mission is extremely dangerous. Recently a whole platoon of Yasker Hawks was deployed there, but not a soul has returned. Well, let's hope you'll be more successful. Maybe you'll even get far enough to meet Stepmother.
As I've already mentioned, the experiments conducted in the lab were on psi-sensitive creatures. The most curious specimen turned out to be a termite queen, for she naturally had strong mental abilities which she used to control the other termites.
I admit, the queen turned out to be a tough nut to crack. Not many psionicists were able to maintain mental contact with her. But the worst part is that she learned from experience. With each new session Stepmother - that's what we dubbed her - grew more immune to our efforts.
She's a dangerous creature, and she's grown far too intelligent. Not too long ago I signed an order to have her exterminated, but the lab was thrown into chaos before it could be done.
If you manage to get deep enough into the lab, please kill Stepmother. We can't let the opportunity to destroy her slip away again. When you're done, report back to Elizaveta Rysina in Nezebgrad. No doubt she'll want to reward you for your heroism.
I was just studying Sevinov's report on the situation at Lab Thirteen. Do you have anything to add?
You already destroyed the queen? That's excellent news! I should send you on missions more often. Here, take this reward and use it to continue your heroics!
Kill Stas Yinov and report his crimes to Negus Kheket in Nezebgrad.

I'm dying... Again... Oh, I'm so sick of all this! How did you get here? Eh, that's not important. If you were strong enough to make it this far and keep your wits about you, then I have something important to tell you. Listen up!
You know Stas Yinov, the Xadaganian Inquisitor? Well, all of this chaos is his fault! When we started the final phase of the experiment, Skulnar was supposed to try and assume control over the Astral demon. Things were going well enough - Skulnar was screaming and twisting in pain, but he seemed to be succeeding.
Then Yinov shouted "In the name of Tep!" and then all these Shadows crawled out from the corners. They went right for Skulnar! Well, he lost control of the demon, and then everything went wrong. The demon got free, undead started appearing all over the place, and those that remained started to go nuts!
I have no idea why Yinov did it. He's one of the Imperial Sentinels, and he's a Xadaganian! Why would he be involved with Tep? Well, the most important thing is to find Yinov and kill him! He's evil! It's his fault that this tragedy occurred.
What news do you have from Lab Thirteen?

I see... So that lunatic Tep is meddling in our affairs, like always, and furthering his own goals all the while. Successfully, I might add. I wonder why he felt compelled to sabotage this project... What could he want with Lab Thirteen? The thing that worries me most is that we won't learn the answers until it's too late.
Find out what happened to Skulnar and report to Wrokag the Northwind in Nezebgrad.

And now to talk about Skulnar. It seems that you're well aware of the... how should I say this... difference of opinion between Crazystorm and Wrokag.
Wrokag still hopes to return to the good ol' days where shamans were supreme. However, the world has changed. The future of the Orcish people is tied to that of the Empire. Nothing can change that, not even an Orcish mutant with exceptional an aptitude for magic.
Even if Skulnar is capable of a few tricks, who cares? Only the Arisen scientists, I would say. They were all over him, calling him a great paradox and a marvel. But alas, I fear that the marvel may have met his end.
All of this chaos occurred on the same day Skulnar's final experiment was to be conducted. He was supposed to take control of an Astral demon. My guess is that he failed, considering the state of things right now.
If Skulnar happens to have survived, I guess the shamans could prevail. If not... then they need to accept their fate. Maybe if you head into the lab you'll be able to find Skulnar's corpse. That would finally put an end to this story about the descendants of the Legendary Orc. Well whatever happens, you should report to Wrokag about what you learned.
Spill it, I want to know everything!

No, this isn't over! Voxar and Skulnar may be dead, but Strina is still alive! It's too early for Crazystorm and the others to be celebrating. I'm not backing down!
So, what are you waiting for? A reward? For what?! For Skulnar's death?! All you 'heroes' are the same! For all the hopes and trust people put in you, you demand payment even when the mission fails miserably!
Well then, go ahead and choose one of these things. But know that you won't be hearing any words of gratitude from me!
Kill the Astral Executioner, get the Portal Fragment he carries, and bring it to Yasker.

Oh great Nezeb! Everything is ruined! The experiments were coming along just fine, and the Orc was about to establish contact with the mind of the Astral demon. It clearly wasn't easy and the Orc was on the edge. And that's when Yinov intervened!
He summoned terrible Shadows that attacked Skulnar. He cried out and fell writhing to the floor! That must've been the moment he blew his gasket. And then that madness took over everyone else! He must have unintentionally spread it with his mind magic.
I shudder to remember that scene. I too felt like the Orc for a period of time. The only thing I wanted to do was kill! It seemed more than an average Orcish rage, so it must have been the contact with the demon that twisted him so!
And now that demon is loose, too! He's right down that hallway, and you must kill him! Listen, we put some June golems around the room for just such an event. You can use them to withstand the power of the Astral demon while you take him down.
And for the sake of all that is holy, I beg you to get something called a Portal Fragment from the demon! It's an artifact of unseen power and if it's lost, Yasker will be beside himself with rage!

The most important piece of information is that Skulnar was able to temporarily assume control over the Astral demon.
Of course, there are still a lot of unanswered questions, such as the motives of that cultist named Yinov. And we don't know to what degree was Skulnar was able to connect with the demon. And what caused the Orcish to go mad? The attacking Shadows? The information he received from the demon? Or something else?
We shall find the answers to these questions with research that will be conducted at Lab Fifteen. I've already signed an order to establish the facility.
Meanwhile, I will take the Fragment you brought back. You want to know what it is, don't you?
Well, I suppose you deserve to know. It's a fragment of the Astral portal that was sealed by Nezeb and Skrakan. The same portal the demons used to enter our world.
This fragment is charged with a strange kind of magic that is unknown to us. This is what we used to augment Skulnar's powers so he could assume control over the demon. And it looks like it was working!
Your outstanding services in this investigation shall not be forgotten by me or the Empire. When we complete our objective and declassify information on Lab Thirteen, your name shall be one of the first on the list of national heroes.
Until then, please keep silent and accept this as your reward.
Find Tensess' Soul and save him from the demons.

We'll win this battle, I just know it! But Gorluxor turned out to be a very powerful enemy. I suppose I should have expected that from a fellow Great Mage.
I don't think I'm going to make it through this. That means you'll have to go on without me and make sure the demons don't accomplish their goals. All of Sarnaut is counting on you! Head deeper into the Temple and protect Tensess' soul from harm.
Come closer, oh warrior of the Light.
Relay the words of Tensess to Yasker, the leader of the Empire.

So, you came to save me? Thank you brave hero, although it's the world you should be concerned about, not me.
You might have noticed that the demons started resurrecting after death. Their goal wasn't to destroy me - it was to learn to use the power of the Light for themselves. They were very close to fulfilling their goal, too.
Once I gave the gift of life to the world. Now it's time for me to give another gift - the gift of death. My death. Don't worry, my Gift won't disappear after I'm gone. The power of the Light shall remain, but with my death it can no longer become their prey.
And as for me - my life was long and wonderful. I was able to fill the world with Light for many years, and so I have no regrets. Please do not grieve for my loss.
I have one more thing to say before I go - the League and the Empire must unite! The demons are still a threat to this world, and without unification they cannot be defeated. Please relay my last testament to your leader. Now, I must bid you farewell...

Tensess is dead? This is horrible news for every creature in Sarnaut!
...What's that? In Tensess' last testament he told us to ally with the League? That can't be right. That's ridiculous! Well, maybe we can discuss that more later. Right now we must mourn Tensess' loss.
Enter Tensess Temple and speak with Tensess' Soul.

As I'm sure you already know, there is one major difference between the religious beliefs of the League and the Empire. The League believes that Tensess is the only source of the Light, and that the gift of resurrection is his gift, period. We, on the other hand, know that Skrakan and Nezeb are just as holy.
I've figured out a way to resolve this dispute once and for all. You need to ask Tensess himself for the truth. Fortunately, his spirit resides in Tensess Temple and it's located quite close to us.
Yes, I know that the entrance to the Temple is blocked. But I'm sure you'll find a way to get in. You have to! Proving that the League is wrong in this matter would crush their morale. Now go quickly - the entire Empire is counting on you!
I can see the question in your eyes that you dare not ask. But fear not, I am ready to answer.
Relay the words of Tensess to Yasker, the leader of the Empire.

I know what you want to ask. I have the answer, but it's unlikely to please you. Simply put, the answer is the Light.
After I died in battle when my soul began to leave my body, I saw a great column of light and I could not resist its power. I was drawn towards it. I remember my thoughts very vividly... That this is what's after death, and that I would soon know the truth about life.
Unfortunately, I never made it to the column of light. Halfway there some other force pulled me away. My soul became captured inside this pyramid. But when I got here I was not alone, although I cannot say who was with me. All I know is that they gave me eternal peace and a new power - the power of the Light.
Initially, the flow of Light was weak and there were very few people who believed in its power. But it was enough that people began to resurrect after death. When they saw these miracles occur, the number of believers started to increase along with the Light's power.
When the Trinity Church sainted Nezeb and Skrakan, the faith of the Imperials grew much stronger and my strength doubled. Do you understand how it works now? The power of the Light comes from faith itself! It's not from me, and it's not from Skrakan or Nezeb.
Faith is something that cannot be understood or explained. And if you try to explain it, people will start to doubt and the Light will grow weaker. Therefore, you must return to the League and tell them something they will not want to hear. Tell them that Skrakan and Nezeb are saints just as am I.
Tell them that the source of the Light is in me, and you, and everyone. Let all of the League believe and the Light will never go out.

So, you met Tensess? What did he tell you? Hm... This is some pretty shocking news. I need a few seconds to think about this.
Hm. Well, at least we know that Nezeb and Skrakan are equal to Tensess. But it seems a bit odd to think that all of them aren't as important as we thought.
Well, this information shall be given to the Trinity Church as soon as it's been approved by the government. Perhaps in a few years it shall become public knowledge. Thank you for your efforts to uncover the truth.
Bring the Blood-Encrusted Letter to Nefer Ur.

Through the filth you can make out a few of the words. It seems this letter was sent by someone named "Gorluxor". He ordered the Dark Artifacts to be delivered to him inside the Temple. It seems that only with their help will he be able to corrupt Tensess' Gift...
This Gorluxor sounds like a very dangerous person. You should probably show this letter to Nefer Ur.
So that's who's behind this - Gorluxor! What a pleasant surprise...
Defeat Voisvet Belov and report back to Elizaveta Rysina in Nezebgrad.

On our way to free Tensess' soul we met a certain obstacle - Voisvet Belov. He's a hard- nosed and stubborn dunce. I offered him a truce until we were able to break through to the top of the Temple and save Tensess, but he refused.
I suppose the good part is that now only we, the Empire, will be responsible for saving the world. We'll be able to throw this fact at the League for years! I'm sure this will raise the morale of our citizens.
Well, since I'm not about to offer sanctuary a second time, that means there's only one way left to deal with that Kanian. Voisvet must be eliminated so our troops can reach the heart of the Temple and save Tensess.
He should be just down this corridor. Kill him as soon as you find him, but don't cut off his head. Let him rise again and live with the shame of defeat!
Do you have any news for me?

What? Voisvet Belov - the Hero of the Great Astral Campaign, the High Knight of the Church of Light - has been defeated? Great job! I'm sure the League will be pretty upset about that. That's just what I needed to hear at a time like this!

secrets: The Battle for the Holy Land

t: Kill Gorluxor and bring his head to Crazystorm the Merciless in Nezebgrad.

Have you ever heard of Gorluxor? No? You should learn more about the history of our country. He plays quite a role in our past.
When Nezeb set out for the Great Astral Campaign, he left Yasker to rule in his place. When Nezeb disappeared, a Great Mage named Gorluxor sought to defy Nezeb's will and seize power over the Empire.
The short-sighted human only tried to gain the support of the Xadaganians, ignoring the Orcs and the Arisen. While they didn't have as many rights as the Xadaganians at that time, the opposition of the Orcs and the Arisen proved to be his downfall. He lost his bid for power.
He disappeared shortly afterwards, and for many years no one has seen or heard from him. But now it appears that he's back and the leader of an army of cultists. I suppose his thirst for power never vanished, and now he's determined to subdue the entire world.
We must defeat this monster together. I will be by your side when the battle commences. I fear this foe may turn out to be even more dangerous than Voisvet. After he's slain, cut off his head immediately so that he may not resurrect. Deliver it to Crazystorm the Merciless when you're done.
Why are you here and not in the Holy Land like other true Imperials?

Whose head? Gorluxor's?! Woohoo, my birthday came early this year! Great job!
This head is worth its weight in gold! Gorluxor is Yasker's sworn enemy! And now he's dead?! Kickass! I can't wait to tell him!
Find Tensess' Soul and save him from the demons.

Curse Gorluxor! He was more powerful than I expected. Great Light, how could I be defeated by an old Xadaganian dog?
I don't think I'm going to make it through this. And I doubt that I'll have time to resurrect and return to the Temple before the demons accomplish their goals. That means everything depends on you! You must be the one to head further into the Temple and save Tensess.
Come closer, oh warrior of the Light.
Relay the words of Tensess to Aidenus, the leader of the League.

So, you came to save me? Thank you brave hero, although it's the world you should be concerned about, not me. You might have noticed that the demons started resurrecting after death.
Their goal wasn't to destroy me - it was to learn to use the power of the Light for themselves. They were very close to fulfilling their goal, too.
Once I gave the gift of life to the world. Now it's time for me to give another gift - the gift of death. My death.
Don't worry, my Gift won't disappear after I'm gone. The power of the Light shall remain, but with my death it can no longer become their prey. And as for me - my life was long and wonderful. I was able to fill the world with Light for many years, and so I have no regrets.
Please do not grieve for my loss. I have one more thing to say before I go - the League and the Empire must unite! The demons are still a threat to this world, and without unification they cannot be defeated. Please relay my last testament to your leader.
Now, I must bid you farewell...

Tensess is dead?
What a horrible loss for the entire world!..
What are you talking about? He told us to ally with the Empire?
Enter Tensess Temple and speak with Tensess' Soul.

What is the main difference between the League's Church of Light and the Empire's Trinity Church? The fact that we're right about the source of the Light. It's Tensess and only Tensess! The Empire is just a bunch of heretics that dare to claim Skrakan and Nezeb as equals!
There's only one way that we can settle this dispute. And that is to go into the Temple and ask Tensess himself! It's pretty clear to me that you're the only one capable of doing this, so off you must go!
I am confident that Tensess will confirm our beliefs. Unfortunately, the Imperial sinners need facts, not my confidence. Find a way to get into the Temple as soon as possible. I don't know how, but you must figure it out. I'm counting on you, okay?
I can see the question in your eyes that you dare not ask. But fear not, I am ready to answer.
Relay the words of Tensess to Aidenus, the leader of the League.

I know what you want to ask.
I have the answer, but it's unlikely to please you.
Simply put, the answer is the Light. After I died in battle when my soul began to leave my body, I saw a great column of light and I could not resist its power. I was drawn towards it. I remember my thoughts very vividly... That this is what's after death, and that I would soon know the truth about life.
Unfortunately, I never made it to the column of light. Halfway there some other force pulled me away. My soul became captured inside this pyramid. But when I got here I was not alone, although I cannot say who was with me. All I know is that they gave me eternal peace and a new power - the power of the Light. Initially, the flow of Light was weak and there were very few people who believed in its power. But it was enough that people began to resurrect after death. When they saw these miracles occur, the number of believers started to increase along with the Light's power.
When the Trinity Church sainted Nezeb and Skrakan, the faith of the Imperials grew much stronger and my strength doubled. Do you understand how it works now? The power of the Light comes from faith itself! It's not from me, and it's not from Skrakan or Nezeb.
Faith is something that cannot be understood or explained. And if you try to explain it, people will start to doubt and the Light will grow weaker.
Therefore, you must return to the League and tell them something they will not want to hear. Tell them that Skrakan and Nezeb are saints just as am I. Tell them that the source of the Light is in me, and you, and everyone.
Let all of the League believe and the Light will never go out.

You saw Tensess? What did he say?
Hm... I don't think the citizens of the League will be eager to hear that.
Before we go and disclose the truth, a lot of work needs to be done. If this news was spread in such a time of unrest it could start an uprising. Perhaps it can be revealed after the war.
Thank you for finally answering this question.
Bring the Blood-Encrusted Letter to Voisvet Belov.

Through the filth you can make out a few of the words. It seems this letter was sent by someone named "Gorluxor". He ordered the Dark Artifacts to be delivered to him inside the Temple. It seems that only with their help will he be able to corrupt Tensess' Gift...
This Gorluxor sounds like a very dangerous person. You should probably show this letter to Voisvet Belov.
What is this? A letter? From whom?
It's from Gorluxor, that old Xadaganian dog! Damn! Why did he have to be involved with this?
Defeat Nefer Ur and report back to Marianne de Ardeur in Novograd.

I've had enough! While I was trapped in here those horrible Historians betrayed us! The betrayed the Light! They're ready to leave the world without Tensess' Gift, the gift of resurrection! When we manage to get out of here, I'm going to make sure all those traitors are locked up!
But that must come later. Right now we must deal with the most immediate threat. Nefer Ur, the Arisen Great Mage, is just up ahead. If he's not defeated the Empire might eventually seize the Temple, and that cannot be allowed!
The League must be the one to save Tensess and end this demonic plague. If the Empire were to accomplish this feat, they would always hold that against us. On top of that, the defeat of Nefer Ur would be a crushing blow to the Empire's morale.
When you win the battle and escape the Temple, tell everything to Marianne de Ardeur, the Divine Prioress of the Church of Light. Let the church bells ring and proclaim the victory of the Light!
May the Light be with you!
Nefer Ur has been defeated? The leader of the Arisen and the right hand of Yasker himself?! What a great victory! This news shall be spread throughout the League!
Kill Gorluxor and bring his head to Izbor Yavorsky in Novograd.

Gorluxor... Is it any surprise that such a monster and criminal was spawned by the Empire?
This Xadaganian Great Mage once fought Yasker for power over the Empire. This happened right after the disappearance of Nezeb and Skrakan. Gorluxor promised to lead all of the Xadaganians to victory over their enemies.
Yasker, however, made a smarter proclamation. He promised to protect not only the Xadaganians, but the Orcs and Arisen as well. By giving all of the Imperial citizens full rights, he received their backing and Yasker is now in charge today.
Damn! It would have been best for Gorluxor to take power. He probably would've destroyed the Empire from within. But once he was defeated, Gorluxor swore loyalty to no one. Now he aims to destroy the world out of anger!
It appears that Gorluxor is leading a large army of cultists that serve the demons. Worst of all, he's posing a threat to the great Tensess! He needs to be killed immediately. This will definitely be a difficult battle, and so I will enter it by your side!
After you kill Gorluxor, make sure to cut off his head. Then his spirit won't be able to return to his body. He wants to deprive the whole world of the gift of resurrection, eh? Well, let him experience firsthand what it's like!
Bring Gorluxor's head to Izbor Yavorsky when you are victorious.
Any news from the Holy Land?
Whose head? Gorluxor's? And you say that this former Xadaganian Great Mage was leading the cultists? Well then, this is quite a feat! I believe that merits a reward.
Pass 3 trials of Ghostly Zak and learn the Tka-Rik Revelation.

I'm a ghost of Ath-Zak, the one who defeated June Curse. This is the last event I remember. Nihaz gave me this form after death but never told me what happened. He said that every story has a best moment to end. The moment of my victory over the curse was such moment.
Do you know who Nihaz is? He is Director. And he is god. God of Darkness. Don't let this word scare you. Darkness, Light... Sometimes it doesn't matter...
So, Nihaz needed me because the aura of my victory over the Curse, the aura of the deadly veil, was the most reliable protection against demons. As long as I'm here, they can't break through the veil and stop you on your way to the Revelation.
The Revelation consists of three parts. If you pass three trials and survive, you will learn the truth about our world.
Tka-Rik, the last Great Mage of Junes, wrote this book of Revelation. We are going to read it now. Tell me when you are ready to turn over the first page.
Have you survived? Great. Try and find something good in anything that happens to you.

Yes, I'm a god. Nihaz, God of Darkness...
You know, I don't like these long titles. I like feeling excited. It becomes important, when you are immortal.
Betrayal of our former allies makes me excited. Well done! What a surprise for daddy!
I have transformed Junes into Wormfaces. Draconids were created by the Great Dragon, but derives his strengths from the same source that I use. All of them are my children, in a way. Stupid kids who betrayed me... How dare they to challenge Nihaz!
What? You can't understand what I'm talking about?
That's because this stupid Zak didn't tell you the whole story. I'll do it. I'll tell you everything about the past and the future. I'll also explain what's going on right now.
Let's talk, shall we?

Well, now you know all I wanted to tell you. Isn't it great?
If I appeared to you in my true form and told you everything you wouldn't understand a thing. In other words, you appreciate knowledge only if you gain it through blood and sweat. Perhaps this is the most important revelation...
Accept the challenge of Nihaz and pass 10 trials in Tka-Rik's Cave, then report to Klavdia Kalugina.

Zak should have been here now, but he has betrayed my father.
Are you ready to accept the challenge of Nihaz and complete 10 trials?
Well, how are you doing? Have you passed all the trials?
Accept Nihaz's challenge and complete 20 trials in Tka-Rik's Cave. Report to Klavdia Kalugina upon completion.

Let's see... Who was it that was thinking of becoming the center of our universe, playing with forces that no ordinary mortal should ever touch? Sure you won't explode from all the prospects opening up? My father doesn't like social climbers... Although I might not tell him anything. It's more interesting this way!
Now listen up. If you want an emblem, you'll have to work for it. Ten tests? Hah! How about twenty? That's what it'll be!
And I see you are trying to compete with the Great Mages? Not good at all...
Unbelievable... All twenty trials are completed! The key is rightfully yours.
Accept the challenge of Klavdia and pass 5 trials in Tka-Rik's Cave, then report to Klavdia Kalugina.

Tka-Rik's Cave is a wondrous place, don't you think so? So old and scary... Are you scared? No? You should be.

Anything can happen here. This "anything" may eat you alive, as well. But as soon as you're determined, let's have a little warm up, shall we?

You will have to complete five trials. If you manage to pass them all, you will receive a reward from me. If not - oh well, you've been warned. What trials? Ah, that's a surprise!

Do you accept the challenge?
Aren't you tired of running about? Don't you want to retreat?
You have passed all the trials successfully. Well done! Come back tomorrow, if you want more. I'll be here. Or not.
Escort Seeress Unn to the pier near the White Fortress and meet Luka Buranov.

No time for talking! Run! The threads are strained, they ring like strings of an elven lyre! I can't see the Pattern of Fates: it is always alive and flowing, but now it is as cold as ice. It bodes not death but oblivion... Run, while there's still a place to run to!
Finally! When the battle ceased, I thought you were dead. I hardly made this cowardly healer wait another couple of minutes!
Escort Seeress Unn to the pier near the White Fortress and meet Ilya Dubinin.

No time for talking! Run! The threads are strained, they ring like strings of an elven lyre! I can't see the Pattern of Fates: it is always alive and flowing, but now it is as cold as ice. It bodes not death but oblivion... Run, while there's still a place to run to!
Ha! I never doubted you'd survive!
You are right in time! That traitor wanted to leave without you, but we ain't leaving our buddies behind!
Mount the Ogre Assaulter, reach the pier, clear it of Architects and cover the evacuation of Dane Hunters.

See that big one? We have been training Dane ogres for some time. Usually, they are as dumb as stumps, but Fedor is quite smart. Pay no mind that he can only say "Fedor!" He's not afraid of shooting and follows your orders. A perfect fighter!

So get on his back and shot at everything you see! We have almost made it to the pier.
Hold on! Don't let the enemies reach the ship!

Thanks Tensess, we're alive! There is the ship! It's just... No, she couldn't have survived.

But still we have to check!
Reach the ship and leave the White Fortress.

So this is the Thread Mistress? Wow! I've never seen a black gibberling in my life...

Enough with the talking, the ship is about to depart. Luckily, we only need to fly a short way to the Shore City. The fortress fell because they were not expected here, but the Shore City will be perfectly defended... If we make it.

You have been away for a week! I hope you have something new to tell us, for we already know about the Architects. Aidenus has sent us a message about the Architects' attack on the allod of Free Traders. Yasker is furious. Go and report to him. Maybe, you can shed light on what is really going on.
Reach the ship and leave the White Fortress.

So this is the Thread Mistress? As far as I know, black gibberlings are gifted visionaries and fortunetellers.

Enough with the talking, the ship is about to depart. Luckily, we only need to fly a short way to the Shore City. The fortress fell because they were not expected here, but the Shore City will be perfectly defended... If we make it.

We thought the Light took you - it's been several days! The whole League is in panic, sinister tidings are coming from the Empire, nobody understands anything apart from one thing - somehow the Architects have broken into our world and attacked the allod of Free Traders! The most interesting thing, Yasker himself informed us in a message... I hope you have something to tell Aidenus?
Talk to Sledge the Fiery and return to Elizaveta Rysina.

A couple of hours ago an Orc is smoking clothes fell out of the Portal in Yasker's Tower. Judging by her armor, she is one of Demon Hunters. But Demons have been keeping away from our allods since the battle of Yazes, and then we crushed them in the Dead City! This is very strange.

I am afraid our guest is a little bit out of her wits. Her mind is wandering in the dark, no matter how hard it try to reach out for her consciousness. She doesn't seem to see me. I remember that you once met Demon Hunters in the Dragon Ring. Why don't you try to talk to her?
So, have you spoken with our guest?

She recognized you! How interesting...

So the fortress fell under the onslaught of "flowing stone"?.. Hm. As far as I remember, the White Fortress is located on Dane, the allod of Free Traders. But is that poor girl really from there? I don't know. Her papers are all tattered and covered with blood. And she herself is as crazy as a rabid goblin!

Looks like we have only one way to find out what happened...
Talk to Pike the Fiery and return to Izbor Yavorsky.

A couple of hours ago an Orc is smoking clothes fell out of the tower Portal. Judging by her armor, she is one of Demon Hunters. But Demons have been keeping away from our allods since the battle of Yazes, and then we crushed the in the Dead City! This is very strange.

I am afraid our guest is a little bit out of her wits. She doesn't recognize anyone and doesn't answer any questions. The healers can't even approach her.

I remember that you once met Demon Hunters in the Dragon Ring. Why don't you try to talk to her?
Talk to our guest. She's from the Fiery clan. Maybe, she will recognize you at least.

White Fortress? Yes, I think I heard something... It's on Dane, the allod of Free Traders. But what on earth is "flowing stone"? What could have possibly happened? Could it be demons?!

Damn it! That orc had some papers, but they are all tattered and covered with blood. Looks like we have only one way to find out what happened...
Use the cracked Adventurer's Stone and find out what happened to the Demon Hunters.

The orc had an Adventurer's Stone, the one just like yours. It's a little cracked though, and I'm not really sure it can be used to teleport. And if it works, only gods know where it might take you.

We must find out what kind of an enemy has destroyed the fortress! I believe no one can handle this responsible mission better than you.

Please don't play hero! Just find out what happened and come back as soon as possible.
What the hell... What are these creatures?

Phew... I don't know what's your name, but you are right in time! They would have killed me in a moment.

Listen! I need to tell you something.
Use the cracked Adventurer's Stone and find out what happened to the Demon Hunters.

The Huntress had an Adventurer's Stone, the one just like yours. It's a little cracked though, and I'm not really sure it can be used to teleport. And if it works, only gods know where it might take you. But we really need to find out what happened to the Hunters! And you are just the right person to scout it out.

Just don't play hero or anything. Find out what happened, and that's it! Come back as soon as you can.
Who are you? Don't grab your weapon, we seem to be on the same side. If it were not for you, that creature would have killed me. What was it anyway?!
Reach the tower in the White Castle together with Luka Buranov and look for survivors.

Listen to what I say. Whether you want it or not, we are in the same boat. I have no idea what these monsters are, but I swear on the Light - Demons are just innocent lambs compared to them.

When a dead man in Demon Hunters' armor fell out of the Portal in the Aidenus' Tower, holding an Adventurer's Stone in his hands, we thought that Demons were attacking us again. So I volunteered to investigate what happened.

That White Fortress stands on the edge of the allod, which belongs to the Free Traders. I don't remember what it's called. Dine or Dane, something like that.

Alright, enough with the talking. We need to find the surviving Hunters, for one thing.
Go down! Come on, hurry up!
Who the hell are you?! Hands up and don't move! Now, who are you and what are you doing here?
